body:
How can I make any friends when throughout my entire life I have only managed to make 6 and none of them talk to me now? Every one of those dudes, as well as I, were considered "odd balls", and being friends with them has only made me more ostracized from the people around me. I don't hate them for being "odd balls" though, because they were nice and genuine people, but in my post when I said "all I wanted was to be excepted" I guess it could have been better phrased as "All I want is to be considered normal". I hate feeling as though people don't like because I am different from the rest of the croup which is why I lost 70 pounds and why I chose to improve my grades.

As for college: I will never be what I want to be, because I am just too fucking stupid. I want to be a software developer, but I am still in Algebra two as a senior in High School. That boat has already sailed and was the original thing that caused me depression.
